question: Which neighbouring country of India was the eighth most populous country in the world, as per the US Census Bureau, by July 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bangladesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Bangladesh is India's neighbour to the east, sharing one of the longest borders with the country.
 
• As of July 2022, Bangladesh was the eighth most populous country in the world with a population exceeding 166 million.
 
• The data was provided by the US Census Bureau, which regularly updates population statistics globally.
 
• The high population is attributed to a high population density and a relatively high birth rate.
 
• Despite its large population, Bangladesh has made significant strides in improving health and education indicators in recent years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Population Density**

 
 
• Bangladesh has one of the highest population densities in the world, with over 1,100 people per square kilometer.
 
• This high density puts pressure on the country's infrastructure and resources.
 
 
 
• **Demographic Transition**
 
 
• Bangladesh is undergoing a demographic transition with declining birth and death rates.
 
• This shift is part of the country's efforts to improve healthcare and family planning services.
 
 
 
• **Economy**
 
 
• Despite its large population, Bangladesh has experienced steady economic growth, mainly driven by the textile industry.
 
• The country is also focusing on diversifying its economy to include sectors like IT and pharmaceuticals.
 
 
 
• **Urbanization**
 
 
• Rapid urbanization is a significant trend in Bangladesh, with cities like Dhaka experiencing substantial population increases.
 
• This urban growth presents both opportunities and challenges for sustainable development.
